items.text: Ngemva kwensuku ezimbili kwaba khona iPhasika, lomkhosi wesinkwa esingelamvubelo; abapristi abakhulu lababhali bafuna icebo lokumbamba ngobuqili, bambulale.
Kodwa bathi: Kakungabi ngesikhathi somkhosi, funa kube lesiphithiphithi ebantwini.
Kwathi eseBethani endlini kaSimoni olobulephero ehlezi ekudleni, kwafika owesifazana ephethe umfuma wamagcobo
elibiza imali enengi; waphahlaza umfuma, wathela amagcobo ekhanda likaJesu.
Kwakukhona abanye abakhulumisana bodwa ngokuthukuthela, besithi: Achithelwani lamagcobo na?
Ngoba lamagcobo ngabe athengisiwe ngemali edlula amadola angamatshumi amathathu, kwanikwa abayanga. Bamthukuthelela kakhulu.
UJesu wathi, Myekeleni; limhluphelani na? Wenzile umsebenzi omuhle kimi.
Ngoba abayanga lihlala lilabo; uba lithanda, lingabenzela okuhle; kodwa mina kalihlali lilami.
Dute 15:11
Yena wenzile abengakwenza; uqalile phambili ukuwugcobela ukumbelwa umzimba wami.
Ngiqinisile ngithi kini: Loba kungaphi emhlabeni wonke lapho kutshunyayelwa khona ivangeli, lokhu akwenzileyo kuzakukhulunywa ngakho, kube yisikhumbuzo ngaye.
UJudasi Iskariyothi, omunye wabalitshumi lambili, waya kubapristi abakhulu ukumnikela kubo.
Sebezwile bathokoza, bathembisa ukumnika imali. Wasefuna ithuba elihle lokumnikela.
Ngosuku lokuqala lomkhosi wesinkwa esingelamvubelo ababehlaba ngalo iPhasika, abafundi bakhe bathi kuye: Uthanda ukuba siye silungisele ngaphi ukuba udle iPhasika na?
Wasethuma ababili kubafundi bakhe, wathi kubo: Hambani liye emzini; khona lizahlangana lendoda ithwele imbiza yamanzi; liyilandele.
Lapho ingena khona, kalibokuthi kumninindlu: UMfundisi uthi: Ingaphi indlu yami, lapho ngingadlela khona iPhasika labafundi bami na?
Yena uzakulitshengisa indlu enkulu ephezulu, eyendlelweyo, elungisiweyo; silungiseleni khona.
Bahamba abafundi, bangena emzini, bafumana njengokutsho kwakhe kubo; balungisela iPhasika.
Kusihlwa wafika labalitshumi lambili.
Sebehlezi ekudleni uJesu wathi: Ngiqinisile ngithi kini: Omunye wenu, odla lami, uzakunginikela.
Hubo 41:9
Baqala ukudabuka, bathi kuye ngamunye: Kungaba yimi na?
Wathi kubo: Ngomunye wabalitshumi lambili, otsheba kanye lami emganwini.
Ngoba iNdodana yomuntu ihamba njengokulotshiweyo ngayo, kodwa maye kulowomuntu enikelwa nguye iNdodana yomuntu! Kungakuhle aluba wayengazalwanga lowomuntu.
Kwathi besadla, uJesu wathatha isinkwa, wabonga, wasihlephula wabanika, wathi: Thathani, lokhu kungumzimba wami.
Wathatha inkezo, wabonga, wabanika; banatha kuyo bonke.
Wathi kubo: Lokhu kuligazi lami lesivumelwano elichithelwa abanengi.
Eks 24:8
Ngiqinisile ngithi kini: Kangisayikunatha futhi okwesithelo sevini, kuze kube yilolosuku engizakusinatha ngalo sisitsha embusweni kaNkulunkulu.
Kwathi sebehlabele ingoma baphuma baya entabeni ethiwa iOliveti.
UJesu wathi kubo: Lizakukhubeka lonke, ngoba kulotshiwe ukuthi: Ngizakutshaya umalusi, izimvu zichitheke.
Zek 13:7
Kodwa ngemva kokuvuswa kwami ngizakulandulela ukuya eGalili.
UPetro wathi kuye: Lanxa bekhubeka bonke, kodwa mina kangiyikukhubeka.
Kodwa uJesu wathi kuye: Ngiqinisile ngithi kuwe: Lamhlanje ngalobubusuku, lingakakhali kabili iqhude, wena uzakungilandula kathathu.
Kodwa waqinisa ngamandla, esithi: Loba ngingaze ngife lawe, kangiyikukulandula. Batsho njalo bonke.
Bafika endaweni ethiwa iGetsemane; wathi kubafundi bakhe: Hlalani lapha, ngisayakhuleka.
Wathatha uPetro loJakobe loJohane, waqala ukudabuka lokukhathazeka kakhulu.
Wathi kubo: Umoya wami udabukile kakhulu kungathi ngingaze ngife; hlalani lapha, lilinde.
Waqhubeka ingcosana, wawa phansi, wakhuleka ukuba, uba kungenzeka, kungadlula kuye lesisikhathi.
Wathi: “Aba,” Baba, zonke izinto ziyenzeka kuwe; susa linkezo kimi; kodwa kungabi njengokuba ngithanda mina, kodwa njengokuba uthanda wena.
Weza, wabafumana belele; wathi kuPetro: Simoni, ulele na? Ubungelinde iawa ibenye na?
Lindani, likhuleke ukuze lingangeni ekulingweni; umoya uyavuma, kodwa inyama ibuthakathaka.
Wabuya wahamba wayakhuleka esitsho wona lawomazwi.
Ebuya futhi, wabafumana belele, ngoba amehlo abo ayenzima kakhulu; babengazi ukuba bazamphendula bathini.
Wabuya ngokwesithathu, wathi kubo: Lisalele liphumula na? Kwanele, isikhathi sesifikile; khangelani, iNdodana yomuntu iyanikelwa ezandleni zezoni.
Sukumani sihambe. Khangelani, onginikelayo useseduze.
Kwathi masinyane esakhuluma, kwafika uJudasi, omunye wabalitshumi lambili, elexuku liphethe imihedla lezinduku, livela kubapristi abakhulu lababhali labadala.
Omnikelayo wayebanike isiboniso sokuthi: Lowo engizakumanga, nguye; mbambeni, lihambe laye, limqinise.
Esefikile wasondela kuye masinyane, wathi: Mfundisi! Wamanga.
Bamdumela, bambamba.
Omunye kwababemi khona wakhokha umhedla, wageca inceku yompristi omkhulu, waquma indlebe yayo.
UJesu wathi kubo: Liphume lemihedla lezinduku ukuzangibamba kungathi ngingumphangi na?
Bengilani insuku ngensuku ethempelini ngifundisa, kodwa kalingibambanga; kodwa lokhu kwenziwe ukuba kugcwaliseke umbhalo.
Luka 19:47
Bonke bamtshiya, babaleka.
Insizwa ethile yamlandela yambethe ingubo emzimbeni oze; bayibamba.
Yatshiya ingubo, yabaleka ize.
Basebemqhuba uJesu bamusa kumpristi omkhulu; babuthana abapristi abakhulu bonke labadala lababhali.
UPetro wamlandela ekhatshana, waze wangena egumeni lompristi omkhulu; wahlala kanye lezinceku esotha umlilo.
Abapristi abakhulu lomphakathi wonke bafuna ubufakazi ngoJesu ukuze bambulale, kodwa kababufumananga.
Ngoba abanengi bafakaza amanga ngaye, kodwa ubufakazi babo kabuvumelananga.
Kwasukuma abanye bafakaza amanga ngaye besithi:
Thina samuzwa esithi: Ngizakudiliza lelithempeli elenziwe ngezandla, ngakhe elinye ngensuku ezintathu elingenziwanga ngezandla.
Joha 2:19
Loba kunjalo ubufakazi babo kabuvumelananga.
Kwasekusukuma umpristi omkhulu phakathi kwabo, wambuza uJesu, esithi: Kawuphenduli lutho na? Kuyini lokhu abafakaza ngakho ngawe laba na?
Kodwa wathula, kaphendulanga lutho. Umpristi omkhulu wabuye wambuza, wathi kuye: UnguKristu, iNdodana yoBongekayo na?
UJesu wathi: Nginguye. Lizakubona iNdodana yomuntu ihlezi ngakwesokunene saMandla, isiza ngamayezi aphezulu.
Dan 7:13
Umpristi omkhulu wadabula ingubo zakhe, wathi: Sisafunelani ofakazi na?
Liyizwile inhlamba; lithini na? Bonke bamlahla bathi ufanele ukufa.
Levi 24:16
Abanye baqala ukumkhafulela ngamathe, bamgubuzela ubuso bakhe, bamdutshuza, besithi kuye: Profetha! Lezinceku zamamukela ngokumtshaya.
UPetro esesegumeni ngaphansi, kwafika enye yamantombazana ompristi omkhulu,
ibona uPetro esotha umlilo, yamkhangela yathi: Wena ubuloJesu waseNazaretha.
Kodwa walandula wathi: Kangikwazi, futhi kangikuqedisisi okutshoyo; waphumela entubeni; lakhala iqhude.
Intombazana imbona yabuya yaqala ukutsho kwababemi khona ukuthi: Lumuntu ungomunye wabo.
Kodwa wabuya walandula. Ngemva kwesikhatshana futhi labo ababemi khona bathi kuPetro: Impela ungomunye wabo, ngoba ungowaseGalili.
Waseqala ukuthuka lokufunga, esithi: Kangimazi lumuntu elikhuluma ngaye.
Lahle lakhala iqhude ngokwesibili. UPetro wakhumbula ilizwi uJesu ayelitshilo kuye lokuthi: Lingakakhali kabili iqhude, uzakungilandula kathathu; waphihlika wakhala.
